_readme: S741, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-27), second read. Two questions at Cabrillo, each page read as the capture reads it. 45306 (Spanish Intermediate Proficiency certificate): its lists print 13-15 and 1-3 under a printed 16, and its note names a stray '4 - 5' the record did not read; total_differs is filed only from a page read. 06381 (Psychology A.A.), with 06352, 06380 and 44992: every list is headed 'Recommended' and read as counting nothing; a reconcile wording rule needs the page's own words for what a 'Recommended' list with 'Complete the following number of credits: N' requires. Two loads. No model call, nothing written.

questions.spanish_figures: Each list's rule line, courses with units and printed figure, the stray '4 - 5' and what it belongs to, and the total line, word for word.
questions.recommended_words: The sentence that says what the 'Recommended' lists are, each list's heading and its 'Complete the following number of credits' line, general education, electives and the degree total.
